common.tagline: Decrepit deep-space refueling station the Empire can't quite be bothered to scrap.
common.famousFor: Long-haul refueling for ships skipping Imperial customs. Cheap berthing for ships nobody is looking for.
common.cantinaReputation: Desert world near Endor. The Crumbling Spires — remnants of a long-dead civilization — dot the endless salt flats. Treasure hunters and desperate spacers pick through the ruins. A backwater fuel depot serves ships that wandered too far off the beaten path.
